name: WonderKB
short: Keeps the Assistant cog's knowledge current from the server's own channels, shop, aliases and guide.
description: Feeds the Vertyco Assistant cog automatically so nobody maintains a knowledge file. On a schedule (and with `.kb sync`) it reads the public channels you choose (default: announcements, server-guide, rules, server-updates, shop), the live shop items and prices, the Alias cog's shortcuts, the Wonderland guide and a short built-in seed, and writes only what changed into the Assistant's embeddings. When the assistant answers "I'm not sure", the question is posted to #mod-chat; a mod teaches the answer once with `.kb add <question> | <answer>`. Needs the Assistant cog loaded with an API key.
end_user_data_statement: Stores per guild: the list of source channels, the mod-chat channel, sync timing, and short hashes of recently logged questions. Knowledge text is written into the Assistant cog's embedding store, which holds public channel text and any answers a mod adds by hand. Nothing about individual members is stored.
install_msg: Needs the Assistant cog loaded with an API key. Run `[p]load wonderkb`, then `[p]kb status` and `[p]kb sync`.
author: evacfk
